output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(

Hi All,

It is done!! 
Below code work for me...

# Create a reactive value to store the random forest object.
rf2 <- reactiveValues()
observe({
  if(!is.null(rf1()))
  isolate(
    rf2 <<- rf1()
  )
})

# Download Random Forest Model
output$downloadModel <- downloadHandler(
  filename <- function(){
    paste("RF Model.RData")
  },
  
  content = function(file) {

save(rf2, file = file)
  }
)

1. Create a reactive Value to store the Random Forest object or any R Object
2. Save the reactive Value in the downloadHandler. 

Thanks
Praneeth
